sources.selection: Authority requires PostgreSQL 18 and the Docker Official Image published exact 18.6 tags at retrieval.
Authority requires RabbitMQ 4.3 with the management UI; the Docker Official Image published exact 4.3.6-management tags at retrieval.
Authority requires Redis 8.x and the Docker Official Image published exact 8.10.2 tags at retrieval.

OpenBao 2.7.0 was the current upstream release tag at retrieval. Its official server documentation states that a configured server starts sealed and must be initialized and unsealed before serving requests.
The official Mailpit project identified v1.31.3 as its current release at retrieval. Authority confines Mailpit to local/test email capture.

The Grafana verified-publisher image published exact 0.34.0 tags at retrieval. Grafana documents this image as a development, demo, and testing stack containing an OpenTelemetry Collector, Grafana, Loki, Mimir, and Tempo.
The Docker Official Image published the exact 1.37.0 tag. It is isolated behind the opt-in app-placeholders profile and supplies no Tunner application behavior.

security_notes: All Compose host port mappings bind to 127.0.0.1 by default; they are development-only and do not imply production exposure.
No image was pulled and no container was started while producing this evidence.
No secret, password, credential, R2 key, or permanent OpenBao root token is committed. P0-007 owns initialized OpenBao, least-privilege policy, and secret injection.
Mailpit remains a local/test sink only; it is not a production email provider or a public service.
limitations: Tag existence is point-in-time R&D evidence, not an image digest pin or a release approval.
Runtime compatibility, container health, and image vulnerability scanning require a separate user-run local validation; this agent did not start long-lived services.
